title: Ictus runtime seam attempt evidence
description: What a runtime backend returns from one bounded attempt through the seam port. It is structured evidence — changed paths, patch digest and size, exit/termination status and a typed failure kind — enough to build a result without reading a log tail. Ictus validates this document's shape and fails the attempt closed on drift; unknown fields are preserved for the runtime's own diagnostics.

failure_kind.description: Null exactly when the outcome is 'succeeded'; otherwise a typed failure kind from the vocabulary below.

changed_paths.description: Paths the attempt changed, as the runtime reports them.

patch_digest.description: Digest of the attempt's patch, or null when it produced none.

steps_used.description: Semantic steps the attempt took, counted through the seam's execution control.

confirmed.description: Whether the process group's death was confirmed. Ictus refuses an attempt that reports a requested termination it could not confirm: a supervisor holding writer exclusion relies on that.
